I don't know who's giving the feedback, I'm guessing the employees of this place themselves. Were family, to say they were disappointed, to say nothing. We were in shock. In this place, the notion of sanitary standards is unknown to cooks at all. At the entrance, we were met with smudged tables and chairs the size of gnomes or children. All the garbage from the table is thrown right on the dirty floor. Also next to each table are trash cans, which line mountains of trash from previous visitors. If cans of beer, napkins and cigarette butts from the floor are still poorly collected after each visitor from the floor, then a mountain of trash in buckets you will observe the entire meal. I had to stay here, because they had just arrived, were tired and hungry, wanted to eat faster and go to bed, it was late and there was no time to look for a more decent place. + false reviews bribed, thought well maybe color such unsanitary Vietnamese. Now for food. They ordered crab, oysters, rice and pancakes and some fish. The rice and pancakes were relatively delicious, and the oysters were frankly rotten and bitter. But before we knew it, we had time to try it. The waiter was called in, they said the oysters weren't fresh, he just shrugged. The crab was put on the table without everything. Undivided, in a shell, without appliances, gloves or a spare plate, just put up and that's it, eat whatever you want. When they asked for the appliances, they took out as a favor (yes, they walk around with such faces - as if doing you a favor that you are even noticed once in a while) scissors and forceps, which could not be done because of the years of their use. They asked for gloves, brought one for three. They asked for more gloves, two more pairs came through the wait. They asked them to cut the crab themselves, cut them into piles - broke the shell in the end as best they could. Yes, by the way, appliances and napkins on the tables were also not at all, in the end brought not eye clean forks, wiped themselves with alcohol. The chopsticks have been on so many sights that their tips have been bitten by previous visitors. My husband wanted fish, we were led to a fish display case with fish in the sun. I said let's not do that, pointed at the barely floating in the aquarium. We had it cooked for 40 minutes because it was just forgotten. The cooking continued when we reminded. And the cherry on the cake)). When the fish was ready, it was taken to the cook for cutting. And I was sitting across from the kitchen, watching what the cook was doing. So before that, he was picking his head. He was given a fish and stretched his bare hands towards it. I jumped up, made her wear gloves and watched the whole process make sure everything was done. Staying in this garbage was no longer enough, we paid and left (oysters didn't count). Now for drinks. Cold drinks are just beer and that's it. No water, no lemonade, nothing else - drink warm. Don't trust the reviews! Don't give these disrespectful people your money. One star for this disgusting place is too many.

Must-try in NHA TRANG
Nov 2024 • Friends
If you're looking for an incredible seafood experience in Nha Trang, Oc Ghien is a must-visit! The BBQ fish with chili salt is perfectly grilled with just the right balance of spice, delivering a smoky, flavorful kick. The steamed shells with ginger are a standout as well—fresh, tender, and aromatic, a true taste of the sea.

Prices are reasonable, making it a great choice for both locals and tourists wanting to enjoy authentic Vietnamese seafood without breaking the bank. Oc Ghien NHA TRANG comes highly recommended for anyone visiting the area.

Freshest Seafood in Nha Trang
Feb 2024 • Couples
You will not find fresher seafood in Nha Trang. They only keep the seafood for 2 days before the staff removes it and eats it themselves. They keep the fish on ice and the eyes are always clear (if you know you know). They have an abundance of sauces, but make sure you ask for both green sauces. One has a creamy quality to it and the other is all about the fresh herbs and lime. Both are amazing. I cannot recommend it enough.
